# Volumetric fog

Fog with volume: rays march from the camera through height fog that drifts with noise, collecting light scattered toward the viewer (stronger looking toward the light). It renders at reduced resolution.

<EffectDemo effect="volumetric-fog" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { volumetricFog } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/volumetric-fog';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(volumetricFog({ preset: 'groundMist' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.density = 0.12`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type                                                       | Default            | Range                | Description                                                                |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `density`     | number                                                     | `0.12`             | 0 – 2                | Fog density at and below the fog height; 0 turns it off.                   |
| `height`      | number                                                     | `0`                | -20 – 20 scene units | World height where the fog starts thinning.                                |
| `falloff`     | number                                                     | `0.6`              | 0 – 5                | How quickly the fog thins above its height.                                |
| `maxDistance` | number                                                     | `40`               | 1 – 500 scene units  | Farthest distance marched, also for the sky.                               |
| `noise`       | number                                                     | `0.6`              | 0 – 1                | How patchy the fog is.                                                     |
| `noiseScale`  | number                                                     | `0.4`              | 0.05 – 4             | Size of the patches: higher values make smaller ones.                      |
| `wind`        | [x, y]                                                     | `[1, 0.3]`         | -1 – 1               | Drift direction across the ground (x, z).                                  |
| `windSpeed`   | number                                                     | `0.3`              | 0 – 3                | How fast the patches drift.                                                |
| `light`       | [x, y, z]                                                  | `[-0.4, -0.6, -1]` | -1 – 1               | Direction the light travels, in world space.                               |
| `anisotropy`  | number                                                     | `0.5`              | -0.9 – 0.9           | Forward scattering: higher values glow more when looking toward the light. |
| `color`       | hex color (theme: [`surface`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#9fb2cc'`        |                      | Color of the scattered light.                                              |
| `brightness`  | number                                                     | `1`                | 0 – 4                | Brightness of the scattered light.                                         |
| `steps`       | integer                                                    | `24`               | 8 – 64               | March steps per ray: more are smoother and slower.                         |
| `resolution`  | number                                                     | `0.5`              | 0.25 – 1             | Fog buffer size relative to the frame.                                     |
| `seed`        | integer                                                    | `0`                | 0 – 9999             | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames.    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                                             |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `groundMist` | `density: 0.4`, `falloff: 2`, `height: -0.5`, `noise: 0.7`                           |
| `haze`       | `density: 0.05`, `falloff: 0`, `noise: 0.2`                                          |
| `stormy`     | `density: 0.25`, `windSpeed: 1.2`, `noise: 1`, `color: '#6b7685'`, `brightness: 0.7` |
| `backlit`    | `anisotropy: 0.75`, `light: [0, -0.2, 1]`, `brightness: 0.8`                         |

Apply one with `volumetricFog({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Atmosphere & lighting · tracked as story X10.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads depth, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`windSpeed: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 8.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/volumetric-fog`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Exponential height fog ray-marched in world space; Henyey and Greenstein, Diffuse radiation in the galaxy, 1941 (phase function); Hillaire, Physically based and unified volumetric rendering in Frostbite, 2015 (energy-conserving integration).

## Related

- [Depth fog](./depth-fog) — Screen-space fog from the depth buffer: linear or exponential with distance, optionally thinning above a height for ground mist.
- [God rays](./god-rays) — Light shafts that stream from a light past the objects in front of it, as sunbeams through dusty air.
- [Ambient occlusion (SSAO)](./ssao) — Darkens creases, corners and contact points where ambient light is blocked, from a normal-oriented hemisphere of samples around each pixel.
